metadata.case_name: LAM KWOK LING v. LAM KWOK WING AND OTHERS

injuries.description: fracture of the right distal radius
source: The plaintiff consulted the Accident and Emergency Department of Yan Chai Hospital on 2 August 2008 with swelling and tenderness over the right wrist, and was diagnosed with a fracture of the right distal radius.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture at wrist or hand level

injuries.description: De Quervain tenosynovitis, or the De Quervain syndrome
source: On 12 October 2009, he attended the Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology at North District Hospital. He was diagnosed with De Quervain tenosynovitis, or the De Quervain syndrome.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of extensor muscle, fascia or tendon of thumb at wrist or hand level

manifestations.description: residual pain in his wrist limiting his ability to use heavy implements and to play badminton
limited movement and stiffness of the wrist
spasm in his right thumb and index finger when he tries to hold his fist together or grip something
positive Finkelstein's test suggestive of De Quervain's syndrome
passed out for about 10 seconds after the fall

treatments_received: psychiatric consultation (referred to Dr Lam Tat Chung; consulted on 8 occasions)
treatments_future: one or two steroid injections (should be considered; plaintiff previously refused)
surgical decompression (release of thickened fibrous sheath) as treatment of choice in occasional persistent cases

losses.description: Lost all confidence in doing construction site work and will not be able to return to his pre-accident carpentry work whether on construction sites or in interior decoration projects.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Residual pain limits ability to play badminton which used to be his favourite sport.
Reduced function of right wrist with weakness of grip and reduced range of motion following fracture and subsequent De Quervain syndrome.
